mapper.update: update emp set username=#{username}, name=#{name}, gender=#{gender}, phone=#{phone}, job=#{job}, salary=#{salary}, image=#{image}, entry_date=#{entryDate}, dept_id=#{deptId}, update_time=#{updateTime} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select e.*, d.name deptName from emp e left join dept d on dept_id = d.id where e.id in(#{id})
select (case job when 1 then '班主任' when 2 then '讲师' when 3 then '学工主管' when 4 then '教研主管' when 5 then '咨询师' else '其他' end) as pos, count(*) as number from emp group by pos order by number
select (case gender when 1 then '男性' when 2 then '女性' else '其他' end) as name, count(*) value from emp group by gender;
mapper.delete: delete from emp where id in(#{id})
